_comment: Copy this to .private-terms.json in the repository root and edit it. That file is git-ignored on purpose: a list of things that must not be published is itself a list of private things.
_why_every_language: List a term in EVERY language it could appear in. A translation pass once renamed a client material from Portuguese to English mid-cleanup, and the scanner looking for the Portuguese name waved the English one straight through.
